statement: The diagram weight filtrations have the following properties. 1. For the product S × M, with M a complex algebraic variety, the ordinary Künneth isomor- phism identifies its mixed Hodge structure with that on H∗ (S, Q) ⊗ H∗ (M, Q), where every Ha(S, Q) is pure of weight zero and type (0, 0), and H∗(M, Q) has its Deligne mixed Hodge structure. If S is oriented and closed of real dimension dS, projection pullback and integration over S preserve weight; the latter has cohomological degree −dS. 2. Pullbacks by maps of flat bundles preserve weight. 3. Suppose u : Ht → H ′ t is a proper map of flat bundles with smooth equidimensional algebraic fibers. Put c = dimC H′ t −dimC Ht. With the complex orientations on the fibers, its ordinary Gysin map satisfies u∗ : WaHj (Ht) −→ Wa+2cHj+2c (H ′ t ). If S is oriented, this is the Gysin map for the induced orientations on the total spaces.
